correctness.rationale: Each overpartition part contributes (1+q^j)/(1-q^j), and forced presence of an odd part contributes the ratio 2q^j/(1+q^j); the exact survival coefficient identity follows. The conditioned Boltzmann model decomposes parts into independent geometric G_j and Bernoulli B_j and forced presence changes only the odd Bernoulli part and shift. Common geometric factors yield an all-m uniform Fourier bound, while uniform lattice LLT for m=O(t^(-1/2)) identifies the survival at m~yn^(1/4)/2 as exp(-πy²/16). The all-m Gaussian majorant supports uniform integrability of every fixed positive moment, giving Gamma constants. Independently computed two algebraically distinct generating-function coefficient methods for n≤75 and m≤6, 532 exact coefficient comparisons. Finite checks are not the limit proof.
